ph: After bathing Lord Harikrishna Maharaj in the ocean waters, Swamishri prays for rain in the whole of Gujarat and offers obeisance to the sun-god. 14 Sept 99

w: At 11.30 am Swamishri visited the Sanatan Mandir that was under construction and showered flowers on the unconsecrated murtis.

The evening assembly was declared as Kishore Day. Firstly Lord Harikrishna Maharaj was honored by carrying out a colourful procession that concluded in the assembly hall. The Kishores of Los Angeles performed a drama 'Drishta' and presented a slide show of Swamishri's memories during his 7-day stay in Los Angeles.

The Kishore Day programs in the evening assembly was based on the theme of "Tu Din Kahe to din..." After a speech by sadhus, the Kishores performed a drama, "Hari gamtama rahevuji..." After a folk dance by the kishores, Swamishri blessed the assembly emphasizing on obeying God's commands.

The shraddh assembly commenced after Swamishri's puja. Students of 'Pramukh Swami Vidya Mandir' performed a traditional dance on the lyric 'Malya mune Shastriji Maharaj'. Pujya Brahmadarshan Swami, Pujya Ghanshyamcharan Swami, Pujya Siddheshwar Swami and Shri Haka Bapu spoke about the glory of Shastriji Maharaj and his love for Swamishri. After the rendering of bhajan 'Gunatit ka danka alamme...' by sadhus, Swamishri blessed the assembly. He said, "Shastriji Maharaj established this organization from nothing. At that time we had nothing. And in those circumstances Shastriji Maharaj built such huge mandirs and developed the Satsang organization. Its glory has spread throughout the world. If one is proud of this then one should experience joy and spirit of being blessed. Shastriji Maharaj's work was not a show. He had come on this earth with the principle preached by Shriji Maharaj. His mission was to explain the knowledge of Akshar and Purushottam ..." More than 13,000 devotees attended the festival and had mahaprasad of dudhpak.
ph: Swamishri performs puja on Shraddh day with the murtis of Akshar Purushottam Maharaj and Shastriji Maharaj in the backdrop

w: Arrangements had been made to celebrate the Jaljhilani Ekadashi festival at the Yagnapurush Sarovar. A stage had been erected in the middle, with the sadhus and devotees seated on the banks. After the traditional Vedic mahapuja rituals, Swamishri bathed Shri Harikrishna Maharaj. Then, as per tradition Swamishri sat with Thakorji in a motorboat and sailed around the Yagnapurush Sarovar five times. After each round arti was performed and thal was offered to Shri Harikrishna Maharaj.

A young doctor met Swamishri. He was studying surgery, but because he found it difficult he was feeling depressed. He even contemplated on committing suicide. Swamishri asked him, “Why do you feel this way.” He replied, “No matter how hard I work I simply can’t cope up. Because of this my seniors are harassing me. I feel as if I won’t be able to study at all.” Swamishri advised, “If that is so then change your subject to another stream of medicine. Don’t ever contemplate committing suicide. There is no need to die. And don’t slip into the habit of addictions. Pray to God. I too will pray for you. Things will work out well.”

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.
1 September 2008, Amdavad
Arpit Patel performed seva during the day and stayed awake for three nights to read the entire biography of Bhagatji Maharaj.
5 September 2008, Amdavad
11-year-olds Harshil and Ghanshyam Bhavsar performed a dandvat yatra from Sabarmati suburb to mandir in Shahibaug. Harshil and Ghanshyam performed 2,165 and 2,300 dandvats respectively .
6 September 2008, Amdavad
87 devotees pilgrimaged 22 km by foot from Kalol town.
9 September 2008, Amdavad
Himanshu performed 2,058 dandvats from Sabarmati suburb.
10 September 2008, Amdavad
Divyakant, a child, pilgrimaged by foot from Memnagar to Amli Vali Pol and from there he performed dandvats to the mandir in Shahibaug.
11 September 2008, Amdavad
Five youths cycled 300 km from Sankari to Ahmedabad.
12 September 2008, Amdavad
Vimal P. Panchal performed 2,032 dandvats from Isanpur suburb to Shahibaug Mandir.
13 September 2008, Amdavad

24 male and 18 female devotees and 4 children pilgrimaged 30 km by foot from Bavla. Nine-year-old Niket Gajjar and his elder brother, Darshan Gajjar, performed dandvats from Navarangpura and their 3½-year-old sister walked along with them.

In his letter writing, Mahant Swami Maharaj never writes, "These are our blessings." He always writes, "Swamibapa's blessings are there, and this is our prayer." On the phone too he speaks in the same way.
In this connection, today, while writing a letter of blessings, the attendants said to Swamishri, "Please write that these are your blessings." But on this matter Swamishri kept saying "No".
So the attendants requested, "Swami! Now you are seated as guru. So everyone expects to receive your blessings."
Even so, he did not leave the path of servitude and wrote, "I have prayed to Harikrishna Maharaj and Pramukh Swami Maharaj. These are our prayers and blessings!"
Seeing this, everyone was immersed in Swamishri, an ocean of servitude.

Today Divyanandas Swami came to Mahant Swami Maharaj's room to meet him. Since this sadhu had had an operation on his leg, he was sitting in a wheelchair. Another sadhu had brought him up to Swamishri and left.

After a while the conversation ended. Now the sadhu had to go out, but who would push his wheelchair? That question arose, because since the matter was personal, there was no one in the room except that sadhu and Swamishri.
But just then Swamishri himself got up and took hold of the wheelchair's handles. Before the sadhu in the wheelchair could say anything, Swamishri had taken the wheelchair out of the room!

All who saw this astonishing sight here were speechless. The sadhus ran to take the wheelchair, but Swamishri would not give it, and laughing, he pushed the wheelchair all the way to the outer veranda.

To everyone, that wheelchair seemed to glide on the two wheels of Swamishri's humility and spirit of service. At that moment Swamishri, completely unaware of his status as guru, appeared as the very embodiment of the dharma of service.

Today was Mahant Swami Maharaj's birthday, so as soon as they got the chance, the sadhus present in the room offered prayers one after another. Then the flow of conversation turned towards old memories. In the middle of this, Swamishri suddenly looked at Brahmviharidas Swami and said, "The story of the watch."

Brahmviharidas Swami was stunned. He said, "Swami! You know everyone's heart. This very thing had come to my mind, and Swami! What a fine detail you have remembered!" Then, describing the incident in detail, he said:
"On the 1986 tour, my watch was lost. I searched a great deal, but I could not find it. Swamishri gently said to me that that person must have it!
Now this conversation must have taken only a few seconds, and Swamishri still remembers it! He caught what was in my mind. Truly, Swami! You know everyone's heart."
Today, after giving diksha to three young men, Mahant Swami Maharaj began his blessings:

"In Yogi Bapa's time, all of us youths travelled with him. We had no dharma, knowledge, detachment or devotion at all. We knew nothing about vows and fasts. We were completely blank, but we were swept away and drawn by Yogi Bapa's love. Then whatever command he gave, we accepted with joy."
Only a guru who is fully worthy of being guru can sit in the guru's seat and say such words.

On this auspicious day, all the sadhus began coming in turn to receive prasad from Mahant Swami Maharaj's hands, and Swamishri with his own hands distributed puranpoli (sweet stuffed flatbread) as prasad to all the sadhus.
At the end, Swamishri said, "Priyeshmuni Swami is left."
More than 90 sadhus were present, but even the fact that one of them had been left out was in Swamishri's mind! He specially called him and gave him prasad.
This great sadhu is such that he himself keeps note of who is left and who has come.

ds.t: A letter from a Muslim devotee
w: Today a letter came to Mahant Swami Maharaj from a devoted Muslim woman, which is as follows:
Your Holiness, P.P. Mahant Swami.

My name is Samira Early. In the past 20 years, I have learned to love and find deep meaning in BAPS. Although both of my parents are Muslim and growing up in a Muslim home, I grew to love Pramukh Swami Maharaj and have found his teachings to lead me in many ways in my life's path.

Just yesterday, I learned about the Thakorji Tula at Akshardham in New Jersey. I am very fond of murtis, I have my own Nilkanth murti in my home. It brings me peace, as I pray to it for Swami, for family and friends, when someone falls ill, for whole communities when turmoil strikes areas of this world, and when Pramukh Swami Maharaj passed away.

I learned a long time ago that Akshardham was a dream of Pramukh Swami Maharaj. It was very unfortunate that I did not have the opportunity to see Pramukh Swami Maharaj when he was in the US the last time before his passing. So, when I learned about this ceremony yesterday, I felt very compelled to be a part of it, in ANY way.

Please accept as a donation, my gold bracelet. This comes from deep within me, wholeheartedly. This is not just a piece of jewelry to me, this bracelet is very significant, as it was given to me by my parents on my wedding day. I shared with my mom and dad this morning, that I wanted to donate this bracelet. They gave me many blessings to do so, and they are very proud of me. God willing, as I become more successful in my career, I would like to begin to donate 10% of my earnings in the future to BAPS.

I admire the unity that BAPS invokes within the family, community, and religion, no matter your background or culture. Most of all, I admire the preaching of being humble and egoless, as this will lead to ultimate happiness and harmony within our lives.
I know it's your birthday, so I have already prayed for your health to carry you over 100 years old. Happy birthday to you, Your Holiness, P.P. Mahant Swami !
With love,
Samira Early
(Gujarati translation of the letter:) Param Pujya Mahant Swami...

My name is Samira Early. For the last 20 years I have been learning the deep meaning of "love and life" from BAPS. My parents are Muslim, and I grew up in a Muslim home, but I have love for Pramukh Swami Maharaj, and his inspiring words are guiding me in many ways on my life's path.

Only yesterday I learned that a tula (weighing ceremony) of Thakorji is taking place. I love murtis very much. I have a murti of Nilkanth Varni in my home. Swami! When I have prayed before it when my family or friends fell ill, when there was unrest in the world, and when Pramukh Swami Maharaj went to Akshardham, this murti has given me the greatest peace.

A long time ago I learned that Akshardham is Pramukh Swami Maharaj's dream. It is very unfortunate that I did not get the chance to have his darshan when Pramukh Swami Maharaj last came to America before going to Akshardham. And when I heard about this tula yesterday, I felt that I must surely take part in it. Please accept this gold bracelet of mine. I have sent it with the feeling of my heart. It is not just a piece of jewellery. It is very important to me, because my parents gave it to me on my wedding day. When I told my parents about this donation this morning, they too gave me many blessings and they feel proud of me for it. And if it is Bhagwan's wish and I become more successful in my career, I want to begin giving 10 percent of my income to the BAPS organisation.

I very much like that the BAPS organisation brings unity in the family, society and religion, whatever the culture may be. Most of all, I admire the teaching this organisation gives of becoming humble and free of ego, because it leads our lives towards the highest joy and harmony.
I know that today is your birthday, so I have already prayed for your health and for you to complete 100 years.
Param Pujya Mahant Swami! Very many happy wishes to you on your birthday.
With love,
Samira Early.
A woman writes a letter... and a Muslim at that...! And she speaks of dedication...!! And she prays for Swamishri to live a hundred years...!!!
Truly, this letter says a great deal!
